rows.text: Paste or enter the schema event as json. It is saved under a unique name in the schema triggers folder, which registers it.

rows.label: Schema Event (json)
rows.hint: Schema event json defines the file schema and the source file location to use as file key

rules.message: Please provide a Schema Event json
Schema Event is not a valid json

rows.text: Leave a field blank for no filter. Saving replaces the tab's filters, a session id filter included. A file's session has no process name, so selecting a process lists only the sessions of its runs.

rows.label: File Key Contains
rows.hint: Any portion of the file key, such as medical_claims

rows.label: File Key Date After
rows.hint: The year, month and day in the file key: A date (2026-11-08), a date and time (2026-11-08T15:00:00Z), or a duration ago (3 days)
